claimReview.title: Capito correct that school funding in Biden’s relief bill extends through 2028 – PolitiFact

claims.text: President Joe Biden’s American Relief Plan “has a lot of money in it for schools, but if you really look at it … it says that the school money is going to go out until the year 2028.”

claimReview.title: Trump did not ask supporters for $421 million to help him recover from COVID-19 – PolitiFact

claims.text: Says Donald Trump’s reelection campaign emailed supporters to “donate to help him recover from” COVID-19.
